question: Что такое Set and frozenset и как это работает?
short_answer: `set` is a mutable unordered collection of unique hashable elements; `frozenset` is its immutable hashable variant.
junior_answer: `set` is a mutable unordered collection of unique hashable elements; `frozenset` is its immutable hashable variant. Membership, add and remove are average O(1) through hashing. Union `|`, intersection `&` and difference `-` express standard set operations. Важное ограничение: Set iteration order is not a business contract. Sorting is required when output order matters; converting to set also discards duplicates.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с Set and frozenset?
follow_up_answer: Returning `list(set(values))` from an API silently loses deterministic ordering.

common_wrong_answers: Returning `list(set(values))` from an API silently loses deterministic ordering.
